up: List the compounds reported in the document identified by the ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2069259'. For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID, the preferred name, the maximum clinical development phase, the molecule type, and the canonical SMILES string.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2069259';
